Advanced Manufacturing and Superior Quality Control

Excellence begins at the farm. We partner directly with sustainable agricultural networks to source mature, nutrient-rich Indian gooseberries. Next, our stringent sorting process ensures that only unblemished fruit enters our production lines. Following careful washing and destoning, we utilize precise low-temperature drying methods to preserve the natural phytonutrients, antioxidants, and ascorbic acid inherent in fresh amla. Our advanced milling machinery then pulverizes the dried fruit into a consistent 100 mesh powder. Throughout this entire cycle, our quality assurance team conducts rigorous microbial and physical testing. As a result, every batch achieves optimal moisture control and absolute safety. This meticulous attention to detail establishes us as a trusted leader among indian gooseberry manufacturers.

Precision matters in industrial food processing and supplement formulation. Our amla powder 100 mesh specification ensures seamless integration into dry blends, capsules, and liquid beverages without clumping. Below are the standard technical parameters for our export-grade product:

  • Mesh Size: 100% passing through 100 mesh
  • Moisture Content: Below 7.0% for enhanced stability
  • Purity: 100% natural, free from artificial additives or fillers
  • Color: Natural light greenish-brown to greyish-green
